capabilities: Ask AI questions inline using @agent triggers and a configurable hotkey
Stream AI responses into the note as blockquotes, callouts, plain text, or code blocks
Include wikilinked notes as context for the AI
Create multiple agents with different providers, models, and system prompts
Connect per provider via CLI tools or direct API keys
extras: Desktop only (uses Node.js APIs, not available on Obsidian Mobile). Installable via BRAT for beta testing. Sends active note content, optionally wikilinked notes, and the query to external AI services; privacy policy links are documented, and Ollama keeps data local.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to query LLMs about note content and get streaming answers inserted directly where you asked them.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin from the Obsidian community plugins
Multiple AI providers: Claude, Google Gemini, Ollama (local models), OpenAI

requires.name: Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google AI API key
CLI tool (Claude CLI, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI) or Ollama for CLI/local mode

summary: AI assistant plugin that answers questions inline in notes via @agent triggers, run with a hotkey, using Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, or Ollama.
